ilo_ip.description: IP address or hostname of the HP iLO management interface.

password.description: Password for the iLO user (stored in plaintext — consider filesystem permissions).

port.description: SSH port to use for connecting to iLO.

identity_file.description: Path to SSH private key file (e.g., /root/.ssh/ilo_key). If empty, password auth is used.

ssh_options.description: Additional SSH command-line options (e.g., '-o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no').

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for SSH and iLO command responses.

wait.description: Seconds to wait after powering on a node before checking its status.

ssl.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS support for SSH connections (most iLOs require this).
